claim_ceiling: retrieval-model architecture description only; not TLGP route, mechanism, agency, self, AGI, or EGO evidence

tokenization.adapt_token: sum of learned embeddings for each discrete x dimension, action a, observed effect e, plus adapt segment embedding
tokenization.attention: full TransformerEncoder self-attention over adapt and query tokens; no causal mask
tokenization.input_source: normalized tensors from src.tlgp_001b_r2.meta_learners.build_tensors are rounded back to frozen discrete values for embedding lookup
tokenization.pooling: none; adapt examples are not mean-pooled or collapsed to a fixed summary before query readout
tokenization.query_token: sum of learned embeddings for each discrete x dimension and action a, plus query segment embedding; no effect e input
tokenization.readout: each query token output is passed through a Linear head to K logits
